# MiEdWorkforce Solution API Catalog

Consolidated reference for all API endpoints across domains and platform capabilities. The table below is generated from domain documentation — edit endpoint definitions at the source, not here.

For API design standards (naming conventions, versioning, status codes, error formats), see [api-design.md](../patterns-and-principles/api-design.md).
